about: A tag for each of upstream's idle lines (bot_phrases.json "idle", keyed by the exact text): where and when the line is true or fits (upstream first, gated; port/BotLines). Made by test/line-tags-build.mjs: keyword rules, then a hand review of every line the rules were unsure about (test/ref/line-tags-review.mjs). The words of the lines are never changed.
